title: Max Is Home Sick
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for the McKinley Bulldogs.

pages: One morning, Max wakes up with a hot forehead and a stuffy nose. Ah-choo!
Grandma feels Max's head. "You have a fever. No school for you today."
Grandma sends a note to Ms. Soohoo and to Max's teacher. "Max is home sick today."
Ms. Soohoo writes back, "Thank you for letting us know. We hope Max feels better soon!"
Max stays in bed. Max drinks water, eats soup, and takes lots of naps.
Max misses school. Max misses Lupe and Kai and the class fish.
Grandma reads a book out loud. Max falls asleep before the end.
Max has to stay home until there is no fever for a whole day. That keeps the other kids from getting sick too.
Two days later, Max feels great. At school, Kai gives Max a card that says, "We missed you!"

quiz.q: Who did Grandma send a note to?
quiz.ev: Grandma sends a note to Ms. Soohoo and to Max's teacher.

quiz.q: Why does Max stay home until the fever is gone?
o: So other kids don't get sick
